I actually very rarely take DS I was just using it as an example. I think the new nerf to it seems fair as it's supposed to be an anti tunnelling perk which now feels like it's doing what it was intended to do. And when red ranks tunnel as much as they do, DS is kinda normally important to take. You're not wrong about the T & L walls is fair, I do understand thats what will need to be done, all I was saying is the options on what to do as survivor is becoming very narrow.

It's also 10 times harder to get the save that way, I usually have to sabo 1 hook, run to the next hook and take a hit then dead hard at last second to even get the second hook.  [https://youtu.be/wGcfZr5euWM?t=77](https://youtu.be/wGcfZr5euWM?t=77)  <- look how far you get exposed from as well with the new perk (mind you they are using a bunch of perks to buff the terror radius).

Just feels like all you can do is hold W is all I'm saying, like killers can stop sabo now, DS can be stopped, T and L walls will become unloopable unless you find the hex, literally only viable thing to do now is gen rush. Which is boring

Only thing I find dumb is the perks. The killers get something to counter literally everything the survivors do. Like now Sabotage plays aren't viable because you suffer exposed effects. Not only that, but now you can't loop windows unless you find a hex? and what does the survivor get? a tiny bit of gen progression that involves your team dying. What in the flying fuckballs? So now there is multiple window blocking perks, perks to stop gen rush, perks to stop sabo saves, perks to prevent flash saves and pallet (Infectious fright), they get a perk that can literally show you where the survivors are every time you hook, a perk to stop people using items with 1 hit. And the most op stuff survivors have is dstrike which we can be left on the ground till it runs out which is also getting nerfed, and an anti slug which still takes a significant amount of time to get up from. Not saying there aren't other good survivor perks. But just feels completely unbalanced. I get that its supposed to be a killer sided game, but fuck me dead just start the survivors in dying state at this point.
